scalars.scalar_value: Graduation from high school or evidence of equivalent educational proficiency AND four years of service as a full time, regularly appointed peace officer in a U.S. public law enforcement agency.

items.item_text: resume
transcripts

01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Associate Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree | None of the above

03. How many years of service as a full-time, regularly appointed peace officer in a U.S. public law enforcement agency do you possess? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

04. Do you possess a valid California Peace Officers Standards and Training certificate (POST) Basic Academy certificate? (If you select "Yes", you must upload a copy of your California POST certificate with your application.) Options: Yes | No, but if selected, I am willing, able, and prepared to successfully complete California POST Basic Training prior to my start date | No, and if selected, I am NOT willing to complete California POST Basic Training prior to my start date
05. Will you be eligible for and willing to apply for POST Intermediate Certificate within one year of appointment? Options: Yes | No | I already possess POST Intermediate Certificate

06. If you are selected for this position, will you be able to obtain and provide proof of your possession of a valid California C driver's license upon employment? Options: Yes | No, but I possess a valid Driver's License from another state and am willing to obtain a California Driver's License if selected for the position. | No

07. Do you possess a valid First Aid and CPR Certificates? Please upload copies of your certifications with your application. If you do not upload them with your application, you must provide evidence of valid certifications by the date the eligibility list is established. Options: Yes | No. I understand that I must provide evidence of valid First Aid and CPR certifications by the date the eligibility list is established | No, and I am NOT willing or able to obtain valid First Aid or CPR certifications by the date the eligibility list is established
08. Are you at least 21 years of age? Options: Yes | No

09. Describe your knowledge and experience providing law enforcement services in a college, university, school, or other community-oriented environment. Please include in your response: • The organization(s) in which you gained this experience and your job title(s) • The nature of the community you served • The number of years of experience • Your primary duties and responsibilities • Your experience balancing enforcement responsibilities with safety, prevention, education, service, and community engagement • A specific example demonstrating how you established or maintained positive relationships with the community you served If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

10. Describe your experience performing advanced, lead, training, or specialized law enforcement responsibilities, either formally or informally. Please include in your response: • The organization(s) in which you gained this experience and your job title(s) • The number of years of experience • Your experience providing guidance, training, or mentoring to officers or other personnel • Your experience serving as a Field Training Officer, lead investigator, or in a similar lead or specialized assignment • Examples of complex assignments, investigations, projects, or other responsibilities you have independently handled If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

11. Describe a complex law enforcement situation in which you were required to exercise independent judgment and determine the most appropriate course of action. Please include in your response: • The situation and your role • The legal, safety, operational, and community considerations involved • The available courses of action you considered • How you evaluated risk and exercised discretion • The action you ultimately took and why • The outcome If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

12. How many years of experience do you possess serving as a Field Training Officer (FTO)? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

13. In which of the following organizational settings have you gained law enforcement experience? (Select all that apply): Options: No experience | Municipal Police Department | County Sheriff’s Office | Other Pubic Law Enforcement Agency | Educational Institution or School District | College or University

14. Please select all of the following law enforcement duties you have performed as a regular part of your assigned job duties. (Select all that apply): Options: Coordinated or provided in-service training or instruction to law enforcement personnel | Conducted criminal investigations, including interviewing witnesses, complainants, and/or suspects | Made arrests and completed associated reports and documentation | Prepared detailed investigative or incident reports and maintained related records | Testified in court regarding arrests, investigations, or other law enforcement matters | Responded to emergency calls requiring independent assessment and determination of an appropriate course of action | Coordinated crowd and/or traffic control at special events, or other large functions or gatherings | Responded to complaints or requests for assistance and coordinated with other law enforcement, fire, or emergency agencies as necessary | Provided emergency first aid or other emergency assistance in the course of law enforcement duties | Provided information, direction, and other police service assistance to students, employees, community members, or members of the public | None of the above

15. Candidates who are successful in this examination process may be contacted for future employment opportunities (within this classification) that may be at a different site than where the current vacancy is located. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. Options: District Administrative Center (Located in Camarillo) | Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College

16. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Fulltime Job | Part-Time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work

17. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.
Licenses and Other Requirements:
Valid Califo rnia P.O.S.T. Basic certificate Be eligible for and apply for P.O.S.T. Intermediate Certificate within one year of appointment

Possess a valid California Class C driver's license upon employment Possess valid First Aid and CPR certificates by date of appointment. Meet requirements of California Government Code Sections 1029, 1030, 1031 et seq. Be at least 21 years of age Pass a comprehensive background investigation to determine if the candidate meets department standards Upon receiving conditional offer of employment, pass a medical and psychological examination and meet department standards Successfully complete department field training Pass a polygraph examination
Graduation from high school or evidence of equivalent educational proficiency AND four years of service as a full time, regularly appointed peace officer in a U.S. public law enforcement agency.
Provide safety and protection of students, visitors and personnel . E
Serve as Field Training Officer or lead investigator as assigned; provide work direction and guidance to officers and student police aides on complex assignments; coordinate in-service training . E
Issue and process traffic and parking citations according to established procedures; direct traffic on the campus or at special events . E
Coordinate crowd and traffic control and provide security and police services at special events, assemblies, and other college functions . E
Investigate crimes and other incidents occurring on campus; make arrests, write reports as required; testify in court . E

Patrol college properties on foot or in a vehicle as assigned to maintain order and prevent crime; check and secure doors, rooms, and buildings and safeguard equipment; inspect for vandalism, illegal entry, theft, and fire; report hazardous or unusual conditions or malfunctions; extinguish small fires as necessary . E
Respond to alarm and radio calls; apprehend violators; provide emergency first aid; check and interrogate suspicious persons . E
Receive complaints and requests for assistance from students, visitors, and college personnel; contact other police and fire authorities as necessary . E
Provide information, direction, and assistance to students, visitors, and the public; resolve service complaints as appropriate . E
Ensure accurate accounting of daily parking fees; ensure preventive maintenance on vehicles and life-saving equipment . E
Escort District personnel transporting college funds as needed . E
Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E
Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E
Perform related duties as defined in the Police Policy and Procedures Manual, Police Department General Orders Manual, and policies of the District .
AND
Pass a physical agility test
